scene.head: with_body
scene.ofreeRecent: a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a contemporary private overnight ferry cabin with a round window — she sits back after reaching for a folded blank timetable; a starship data archive — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet modern seaside guesthouse bedroom with pale blue walls — she laughs softly at the distant cry of a gull while sitting up from a deep cushioned window seat; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — seated on a chair; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — carries a camera by its grip at her side

STYLE: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FREE DESIGN: design the place, activity, pose, framing and outfit yourself. Place: a modern miniature railway museum's indoor demonstration platform, beside a tiny brass bell and a miniature railway disappearing around a curve, no other person in focus
Activity: during an adult costume event she listens for the unseen model train, smiling as she predicts the exact moment it will appear around the bend
Pose: seated upright on a short wooden bench in a three-quarter frontal view; her right arm comes forward with her right hand holding the bell handle at chest height, and her left forearm rests on her left thigh with the left hand relaxed; both arms fully understandable and no arm behind her body

Outfit: an original playful railway signal-presenter event costume, no real uniform or insignia: cherry-red short shoulder cape over a securely fitted cream balconette-style sleeveless crop bodice with a deep neckline, turquoise high-cut tailored shorts and short ankle boots; as she turns toward the approaching train, the cape's loose outer panel catches on the bench corner and spreads behind her, uncovering her bare side and shoulder above the secure opaque bodice; bare midriff and thighs, intimate areas covered

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her Three Kingdoms identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
